title: Regional MODIS chlorophyll seasonality
query: Using the provided MODIS-Aqua data for 2003–2012, investigate how chlorophyll seasonality differs between the coastal South China Sea (112–115°E, 21–23°N) and offshore waters (115–118°E, 17–20°N).
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
